scope: Chronicles persons_3 batch03; 60 frozen rows; reviewer did not edit drafts/evidence

primaryWitness.reviewBasis: For every current passage, fixed WEB verse text, URL and verse-text hash are attached in row-level primaryWitnesses; these data establish text parity, not correctness by themselves.

wikipediaReviewMethod.statusVocabulary: linked-* means article body/section read; candidate-found-not-linked means a relevant section was found and current null is a missed candidate; search-complete-* means only the stated pages/queries were checked and does not prove no article exists; held-null is a hold, not a no-fit decision.
searchQueriesUsed: site:en.wikipedia.org/wiki Elkanah/Elnaam/Elpaal/Elpalet/Elzabad names and Chronicles refs

Grouped site:en.wikipedia.org searches covering Ephlal, Eshban, Ethan, Ezbai, Ezer, Ezri, Geshan, Girgashite, Haggeri, Hakkoz, Hamuel, Hanan, Harum, Havilah, Haziel, Heber, Hebron, Heman, Hilkiah, Hushim, Igeal, Ibri
A–K and L–Z shared-index pages opened and queried for target subsections; relevant body lines are listed in bodyReadPages.
wikipediaReviewMethod.note: A search result or title alone was not treated as an identity proof. Wikipedia was assessed as secondary-reference relation evidence, not as the primary basis for source facts.
